primary_text: "I heard you get better tax deductions buying new but my accountant hasn't explained it properly." Here's the short version: brand-new commercial property gives you the highest possible depreciation deductions. Every component — the building, the fit-out, the fixtures — can be depreciated from day one. That means significant tax savings in the early years of ownership. Buying an older warehouse? Most of that depreciation is already used up. These off-the-plan Truganina warehouses are purpose-built, brand new, and fully depreciable. We can connect you with quantity surveyors who'll show you the exact numbers. The tax advantages of buying new are real. Make sure you're claiming them.
